Process Dynamics

Source: R/manMetaVAR-dynamics.R
Dynamics.Rd

Process Dynamics

Usage

Dynamics(dynamics)

Arguments

dynamics

1, 2, or 3. 1 for stable reciprocal regulation, 2 for escalating co-activation, and 3 for adaptive recovery.

See also

Other Data Generation Functions: GenData()

Examples

# stable reciprocal regulation,
Dynamics(dynamics = 1)

#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $k
